accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text on dark backgrounds. Use text-slate-50 for primary, text-slate-400 for secondary.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, course items, filters, calendar days) MUST include specific data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='course-catalog-item-1').

People in a corporate training session in a dark environment

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a strict view-only static React portal designed for enterprise SPOCs. No booking forms. The visual hierarchy must focus on the data (catalog list, calendar, and live seat counts). Use Lucide React icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_execution: Split the main view into two core areas: A fixed or scrollable left sidebar for the 'Course Catalog', and a main central area for the 'Monthly Calendar'. When a course is clicked in the catalog, trigger a slide-over panel (right side) to show the detailed view, or update the main calendar space depending on mobile vs desktop context.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_display: Implement a real-time SSE mock for 'Live Seat Availability'. Use the provided dot indicator styles (green = open, yellow = filling, red = full) next to the numerical count.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MANDATORY: Inject `data-testid` attributes on all navigational elements, course cards, login inputs, and filter dropdowns to support end-to-end testing.
